note: Approvals only. A collection or a record id is added here after an explicit approval by the project owner, or after a documented source comparison made by the AI assistant under the owner's delegation of 2026-10-03 (AGENTS.md section 9). Each entry names who approved and on what evidence. scripts/build-corpus.ts then marks those records reviewed.

collections.scope: Quran collection approved for Azw's text matching. Search spelling, display signs and alternate names are governed separately by docs/DECISIONS.md D-9, D-13 and D-15.
collections.method: The owner personally compared the 10 listed ayat with مصحف المدينة النبوية on 2026-10-02; all 10 matched. The later integrity check compared all 6236 normalized ayat with the Tanzil simple text (docs/SOURCES.md; docs/DECISIONS.md D-15).
openIssues: Quranpedia's published gzip sha256 does not match the served gzip. This is a documented upstream packaging limit, not an unresolved content decision: the decompressed JSON is the integrity anchor (docs/SOURCES.md; D-15).

collections.scope: Sahih al-Bukhari collection approved for Azw's text matching. Covers only records with no reported issue. Does not cover records with damaged text, split (decimal) entries, records whose text block the source repeats under several numbers, records whose text does not open with a formula of direct transmission (docs/DECISIONS.md D-5), or the records in data/review/held-records.json — those stay pending.
collections.method: Approved on automated sample checks; the owner did not compare every record with a printed edition. The raw file is byte-identical to hadith-api commit df57907; 30/30 sampled records matched Dorar by number and matn; 12 records were compared word for word: 8 identical, 3 spelling-only differences, and bukhari:2075 held. Evidence: data/review/hadith-review-sample.json, docs/SOURCES.md and docs/DECISIONS.md D-14.
openIssues: The approval rests on a sample (30 + 12 records); the other records were not compared with a second text.
The source repository does not state which printed edition the Arabic text was digitized from.
bukhari:2075 stays held: its last six words are not in the printed text under this number (Dorar and shamela.ws ط السلطانية 3/57 both end at «أحبله»). docs/DECISIONS.md D-14.

collections.scope: Sahih Muslim collection approved for Azw's text matching. Covers only records with no reported issue. Does not cover records without a citation number, records with damaged text, records whose text block the source repeats under several numbers, records whose text does not open with a formula of direct transmission (docs/DECISIONS.md D-5), or the records in data/review/held-records.json — those stay pending.
collections.method: Approved on automated sample checks; the owner did not compare every record with a printed edition. The raw file is byte-identical to hadith-api commit df57907; 30/30 sampled records matched Dorar by number and matn; 12 records were compared word for word: 6 identical, 1 spelling-only difference, and 5 later confirmed in a second edition. Evidence: data/review/hadith-review-sample.json, docs/SOURCES.md and docs/DECISIONS.md D-14.
openIssues: The approval rests on a sample (30 + 12 records); the other records were not compared with a second text.

The 5 records held after the word-for-word sample were compared with a second edition on 2026-10-03 and released (see records): our text agrees with صحيح مسلم ط التركية in all 5; the differences came from one digital copy.
The source repository does not state which printed edition the Arabic text was digitized from.
